market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $80 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI hit a mid-April low of ~$82.60 (intraday) but currently rallied to $98. 52-week low was $54.98, so settlement has been below $80 at some point in past year. If market was created early enough, may have already resolved Yes. With ~2 months to June 30, another dip below $80 settlement is plausible if Middle East tensions ease. Estimate ~50-60%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Market creation date unknown; if CL settled $80 before Apr, already Yes. Otherwise depends on geopolitical de-escalation.
